name: Terra Toys
notes: Locally owned Austin institution founded in 1978 and known for classic toys, learning tools, art supplies, and demos.

name: Toy Joy Downtown
notes: Iconic downtown Toy Joy location known for novelty, nostalgia, and collectible-heavy browsing.

name: Toy Joy Burnet Road
notes: North-central Toy Joy branch with late hours and a neighborhood-shopping feel.

name: Toy Joy @ The Thinkery
notes: Museum-adjacent Toy Joy outpost in Mueller serving family and gift shoppers.

name: Lakeshore Learning
notes: Educational chain specializing in teacher supplies, learning products, and classroom-oriented play.

name: Monkey See Monkey Do
notes: South Austin hybrid toy, gift, and novelty shop with a browse-and-discover format.

name: Over the Rainbow
notes: Historically significant former neighborhood toy store, once identified as Austin’s oldest independent toy shop.

name: Learning Express Toys
notes: Former Westlake-area family toy store remembered for helpful staff and birthday registry services.
